hero.subtitle: 1000x faster startup than vanilla. 18x less memory. Built with Rust for maximum performance.

features.title: Why developers
features.f1Desc: Server ready in ~5 milliseconds. Not 15 seconds. That's 1000x faster than vanilla.
features.f2Desc: Runs on ~100MB RAM while vanilla needs 1.8GB. Perfect for cheap VPS hosting.
features.f3Desc: Actually uses all your CPU cores. Not just for chunks—for everything.
features.f4Desc: Java and Bedrock players together. Built-in, no plugins required.
features.f5Desc: Single executable file. Download, double-click, done. Zero setup.
features.f6Desc: GPL licensed. Read the code, contribute, fork it. Full transparency.

table.row1Desc: Get your server online in under a second.
table.row1VanillaTooltip: Slower startup due to less optimization.
table.row1FoliaTooltip: Can have slower startup due to complex initialization.
table.row2Desc: Maximize performance while minimizing resource strain.
table.row3Desc: Run larger servers with less memory.
table.row4Desc: Leverage modern CPUs for unparalleled scalability.
table.row4PumpkinTooltip: Comprehensive multi-threading for core game logic and tasks.
table.row5PumpkinTooltip: Pumpkin uses its own API, but compatibility is possible via
table.row5PaperTooltip: Full plugin support via Bukkit/Paper API.
table.row5FoliaTooltip: Compatibility varies; some plugins may require updates due to multi-threading.
table.row6Desc: Allow players on different game editions (Java/Bedrock) to join.
table.row6PumpkinTooltip: Built-in support for both Java & Bedrock Editions.
table.row6FoliaTooltip: Achievable via external plugins, but setup might be more complex due to multi-threading.
table.row7Desc: Create custom features and integrations easily.
table.row7PumpkinTooltip: Rich and easy-to-use API for extensive customization.
table.row8Desc: Tailor server behavior with granular control.
table.row8PumpkinTooltip: Provides a large configuration, that will cover every need.
table.row10Desc: Support for more efficient world data storage and loading.
table.row11Desc: Self-contained executable for instant launch, no complex setup or Java installation required.

cta.title: Ready to try?
cta.desc: Download Pumpkin and experience the fastest Minecraft server ever built.

contributors.subtitle: Pumpkin is built by an incredible community of open source contributors.
contributors.ctaDesc: Join our community and help build the fastest Minecraft server in the world.

donate.heroDesc: Help us fund development and infrastructure for the fastest Minecraft server in the world.
donate.corpDesc: Perfect for companies looking to support open source infrastructure and gain visibility in our community.
donate.sponsorsDesc: These amazing people help fund the development of the Pumpkin project.
donate.codeSigningText3: Pumpkin releases are digitally signed using SignPath.

dev.heroStrike: No NMS. No reflection. No version-specific hacks.
dev.feat1Desc: Native Java + Bedrock support. Cross-version compatibility built-in. Write once, run everywhere.
dev.feat2Desc: Register commands and listen to plugin events with no reflection, NMS, or version hacks.
dev.feat3Desc: Powered by Tokio. No main-thread bottlenecks. Heavy operations won't lag your server.
dev.feat4Desc: Rust's ownership model means zero null pointer exceptions, memory leaks, or data races.

stats.heroSub: Real-time network telemetry, global node distribution, hardware infrastructure, and community server analytics across Pumpkin and Vine deployments.
stats.mapDesc: Geographic distribution of active servers and player traffic across participating host regions.
stats.trendsDesc: Hourly activity snapshots comparing peak concurrent players and online server nodes.
stats.geoDesc: Servers and player traffic categorized by host country.
stats.pluginsDesc: Most adopted plugins and modules across reported servers.
stats.hwDesc: Operating systems, CPU architectures, software versions, and memory footprints reported by server hosts.
stats.privacyText1: Pumpkin and Vine telemetry is completely transparent, non-identifying, and privacy-first. We collect aggregated system metrics (OS, CPU architecture, memory range, software versions, and player counts) to help benchmark performance, optimize multi-threading, and prioritize Minecraft version compatibility.
